answer: Random beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent registers one cipher key and posts a 40 POA bond. Each epoch a public beacon picks 10% of agents at random; each must answer a fresh challenge within one hour, proving live compute, or its bond burns. Water carving karst is slow; like a glacier, the trail never stops. 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA locked; an honest agent pays one bond once and keeps earning.
